name: Lomita City Council
agenda_text:
Lomita City Council
AGENDA
A REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
July 6, 2009
07:00 P.M.
City Hall Council Chambers
24300 Narbonne Avenue
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Councilmember Waite
d.
Roll Call
2.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
3.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. When addressing the Council, please come to the podium and give your name and address for the record. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a 5 minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2 prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
4.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
a.
Approval of Minutes: May 4
b.
Approval of Demands
c.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
d.
Report submitting May 2009 Treasury and Investment Report. RECEIVE AND FILE.
e.
Report dealing with economic development activities. RECEIVE AND FILE.
f.
Report dealing with activities of the parks department. RECEIVE AND FILE.
g.
Report submitting progress report for public works projects. RECEIVE AND FILE.
h.
Report recommending award of contract for auditing services for 2008-09 to Mayer Hoffman McCann PC for $35,700. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
i.
Report recommending reclassification of a field services lead position to an equipment operator position and filling a vacant maintenance worker position. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
j.
Report recommending approval of use of assets seized from illegal narcotic activities. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
k.
Report recommending award of contract for maintenance of Lomita Landscape Maintenance District No 1 to Toyo Landscaping Inc. for $4,440. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
l.
Report recommending award of contract for maintenance of city-wide landscaping contract to Toyo Landscaping Inc for $17,968.80. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
m.
Report recommending approval of the third amendment to the SBCCOG Joint Powers Authority Agreement to allow representation from Los Angeles County Board of Supervisors Districts No 2 and 4. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
n.
Report recommending award of contract for Cypress reservoir and water production facility SCADA system and integration to Tesco Controls Inc for $423,500. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
o.
Report recommending that the Community Services Director continue to execute and submit all documentation required by the city of Los Angeles for the Justice Assistance Grant (JAG) for 2009 and execute memorandum of understanding. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
p.
Report recommending consultant services contract to LaBelle-Marvin Inc for geotechnical design services for Walnut Street, Allbrook Street and Palos Verdes Drive North for $18,100. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
q.
Report recommending consultant services contract to Cetech Engineering Inc for engineering design services for Walnut Street for $12,300. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
5.
LOMITA LANDSCAPE MAINTENANCE DISTRICT NO 1 Public hearing on the proposed assessment for the annual maintenance, operation and servicing of the parkway landscaping along the north side of Palos Verdes Drive North and resolution approving the engineer’s report and resolution confirming the assessment for 2009-10.
Presented by Public Works Drtc Johnson.
SCHEDULED MATTERS
6.
CHAMBER OF COMMERCE Report submitting annual contract with Chamber of Commerce and discussion of possible budget cuts.
Presented by City Mgr Odom.
ADJOURNMENT
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
